events.title: Certiorari Denied in Pittman v. Florida
events.summary: The Supreme Court denied the application for a stay of execution and the petition for a writ of certiorari in the case of David J. Pittman v. Florida. The application was initially presented to Justice Thomas, who referred it to the full Court. The denial means that the execution of the death sentence will proceed as scheduled, and the Court will not review the case.
events.why_relevant: The denial of certiorari and stay of execution affects the administration of justice and the finality of capital punishment cases.

events.title: Stay Granted in NJ Transit Corp. v. Colt
events.summary: The Supreme Court granted a stay in the case NJ Transit Corp., et al. v. Colt, Jeffrey, et al., docket number 24-1113. The stay was granted pending the Court's decision on the sovereign immunity issue, which has already been accepted for review. The stay prevents a damages trial in the Supreme Court of the State of New York from proceeding until the Supreme Court issues its mandate. The Court found no irreparable harm to respondents from delaying the trial.
events.why_relevant: The stay affects the timing and proceedings of a state court trial, pending a Supreme Court decision on sovereign immunity.
